 assert hashlib.sha256((base/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==want

for n,want in manifest['controller_ancestor_sources'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==want,n

assert cli['argv'][:6]==['/usr/bin/prlimit','--as=unlimited','--nofile=1024:1024','--','/usr/bin/python3','-B']
argv=cli['argv'][7:];a=host.parser().parse_args(argv)
assert a.execute and not a.inside_canary and not a.source_audit_only
sr,m,s,ar,art=host.source_inputs(a);assert len(s)==204
warm=host.c.validate_warm({'path':str(a.warm_result),'sha256':a.warm_result_sha256},{'path':str(a.warm_original_operation),'sha256':a.warm_original_operation_sha256})
assert warm['warm_diagnostic_success'] and not warm['full11520_verified']
assert not a.output_dir.exists() and not a.output_dir.is_symlink() and a.output_dir.parent==base.parent
assert host.HOST_MEM==536870912 and host.HOST_VAS==268435456 and host.LEASE==5400 and host.CLEANUP==180

print(json.dumps(dict(argv=cp.args,exit_code=cp.returncode,stdout=cp.stdout,stderr=cp.stderr)),flush=True);assert cp.returncode==0
assert 'torch' not in sys.modules and 'torch_npu' not in sys.modules
